  "summary": "Xu and colleagues evaluate large language models' logical reasoning across 15 datasets and seven model families, introducing a framework for error taxonomy and fine-grained metric measurement beyond answer correctness.",

  "abstract": "The study investigates LLM reasoning capabilities across diverse logical reasoning datasets, analyzing performance variations by prompting style, dataset type, and generation versus classification settings.",

  "conclusion": "LLMs present obvious weakness in the abductive setting."
